title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
raw_excerpt: OpenAI says it is pausing "internal activities" around an in-development AI model, Astra, because it doesn't yet meet new security standards the company is putting in place. The announcement follows its recent disclosure that OpenAI models accidentally hacked Hugging Face . Anthropic and Meta have also since admitted that they had AI models that went rogue and breached other organizations. Recent internal evaluations of an OpenAI model called Astra indicate that it offers "significant advancements in agentic coding and cybersecurity," according to the company . summary: OpenAI宣布暂停其开发中的模型Astra的内部活动，因为初步评估显示其具备“关键性”网络能力，可能带来严重安全风险。这是AI前沿实验室首次因网络安全担忧而主动放缓模型开发。OpenAI将扩大安全测试并遵循“准备框架”，确保防护措施到位后再发布。此举凸显了AI模型在网络安全领域的双刃剑效应。

title: WeatherNext: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
raw_excerpt: WeatherNext is an AI model that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in predicting a cyclone's track, intensity, and wind structure. The model gives forecasters, on average, an extra day's worth of predictive accuracy compared to current methods. Google has open-sourced its WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones models to empower the research community and amplify AI's impact on building more resilient communities. The research has already had real-world impact - it predicted Hurricane Melissa's rapid intensification and landfall in Jamaica during the 2025 hurricane season, enabling advanced warnings to be issued and giving teams on the ground critical time to prepare.
summary: Google DeepMind发布WeatherNext AI模型，在预测气旋路径、强度和风场结构方面达到最先进水平，平均比现有方法多提供一天的预测时间。该模型已在实际中预测了2025年飓风梅丽莎的快速增强和登陆，并已开源WeatherNext 2和Cyclones模型，助力全球气候韧性建设。

title: AMD to Acquire AI Chip Startup Taalas
raw_excerpt: AMD agreed to acquire Toronto-based Taalas, whose custom silicon hardwires AI models to reduce inference compute and memory bottlenecks. Financial terms were undisclosed, and the deal remains subject to regulatory approval.
summary: AMD宣布收购总部位于多伦多的AI芯片初创公司Taalas，该公司专注于将AI模型硬编码到定制硅片中，以减少推理计算和内存瓶颈。交易金额未披露，尚待监管批准。此次收购将增强AMD在AI芯片领域的竞争力，特别是针对推理工作负载的优化。

title: How Modalities Learn Together
raw_excerpt: Meta researchers explored how modalities learn together during pretraining. They also identified architectures that promote cross-modal synergy and recipes that achieved strong generation performance with 5% of the compute budget.
summary: Meta研究人员在预训练中探索了不同模态如何协同学习，识别出促进跨模态协同的架构，并提出了仅用5%计算预算即可实现强生成性能的配方。该研究为多模态模型的训练效率提升提供了新思路，对降低大模型训练成本具有重要意义。

title: AI批量轰炸苹果bug赏金计划，审核团队已下线
summary: 据报道，AI工具被批量用于轰炸苹果的bug赏金计划，导致审核团队不堪重负而暂时下线。攻击者利用AI生成大量低质量或重复的漏洞报告，淹没真实报告，影响安全响应效率。这一事件凸显了AI在安全领域的滥用风险，以及平台需要更智能的过滤机制。
